description: This file defines a repository class 'TagsRepo' for managing tag-related database operations using SQLAlchemy ORM. It provides methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting tags associated with a user.

classes.name: TagsRepo
classes.description: A database adapter class for performing CRUD operations on Tag objects, scoped per user.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the TagsRepo with a SQLAlchemy Session.

methods.name: list[Tag] list_for_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Returns a list of Tag objects associated with a specific user, ordered by name.

methods.name: Tag|None get_for_user(self, user_id: int, tag_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by id for a specific user, returns None if not found or if the user_id does not match.

methods.name: Tag|None get_by_name_for_user(self, user_id: int, name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by name for a specific user, returns None if not found.

methods.name: Tag create(self, user_id: int, name: str)
methods.description: Creates a new Tag for the specified user with the given name and persists it to the database.

methods.name: Tag update_name(self, tag: Tag, name: str)
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing Tag object and commits the change.

methods.name: None delete(self, tag: Tag)
methods.description: Deletes a Tag object from the database.
